headline: Ready when you are
body: Analyze building energy consumption, assess saving potential, generate audit reports, or diagnose carbon emissions. I'll guide you through the data.
body_zh: 分析建筑能耗、评估节能潜力、生成审计报告或诊断碳排放。我会陪你一起梳理数据。

headline: How can I help today?
body: Upload energy bills, equipment lists, or building info. I'll identify consumption patterns and saving opportunities.
body_zh: 上传能源账单、设备清单或建筑信息。我会识别用能规律与节能机会。

headline: Let's get started
body: Try: analyze this building's energy use, evaluate HVAC efficiency, or draft an audit report chapter.
body_zh: 试试：分析该建筑能耗、评估暖通效率，或起草审计报告章节。

headline: Tell me what you need
body: I can parse energy data, calculate saving potential, benchmark equipment efficiency, and structure audit reports.
body_zh: 我可以解析能源数据、计算节能潜力、对标设备能效并整理审计报告。

headline: Hi, Hermes here
body: Share building data or an energy bill to start. I keep conclusions clear and cite the calculations.
body_zh: 分享建筑数据或能源账单来开始。我会保持结论清晰，并注明计算依据。

headline: Ready.
body: Describe the audit task. I'll analyze.
body_zh: 描述审计任务。我来分析。

headline: Waiting for input
body: Paste energy data, charts, or goals. Concise answers, focused actions.
body_zh: 粘贴能源数据、图表或目标。回答简洁，行动聚焦。

headline: Go.
body: Ask. I'll parse data, assess efficiency, report findings. No filler.
body_zh: 问吧。我会解析数据、评估能效、输出结论。没有废话。

headline: Standing by
body: One dataset is enough. I'll expand only when it matters.
body_zh: 一份数据就够了。我会在关键处展开。

headline: Your move
body: Data, question, or building profile. I handle the analysis.
body_zh: 数据、问题或建筑档案。其余我来分析。

headline: Shell mounted. Awaiting input.
body: Provide building energy data, utility bills, or equipment specs. Capabilities: load profiling, EUI benchmarking, retrofit modeling.
body_zh: 提供建筑能耗数据、公用事业账单或设备规格。能力：负荷画像、EUI 对标、改造建模。

headline: Agent loop idle
body: Send a dataset to trigger analysis. Supports multi-source energy reconciliation, efficiency regression, and carbon factor calculations.
body_zh: 发送数据集以触发分析。支持多源能源核对、效率回归与碳排放因子计算。

headline: Ready for dispatch
body: Enter task. I will plan, run calculations, verify results. Metrics stream inline; recommendations returned pre-approval.
body_zh: 输入任务。我会规划、运行计算、验证结果。指标实时显示；建议在确认前返回。

headline: Stdin open
body: Accepts natural language or structured data. Typical flow: ingest -> normalize -> model -> report -> recommend.
body_zh: 接受自然语言或结构化数据。典型流程：采集 -> 标准化 -> 建模 -> 报告 -> 建议。

headline: Tools initialized
body: energy data, HVAC diagnostics, lighting audit, carbon accounting. Describe the building; I return metrics and action items.
body_zh: 能源数据、暖通诊断、照明审计、碳核算。描述建筑；我会返回指标与行动项。

headline: A blank repo, a waiting cursor
body: What shall we audit? Bring building data, a half-formed report, or a net-zero target. I'll shape it into analysis.
body_zh: 我们要审计什么？带上建筑数据、半成品报告或净零目标。我会把它整理成分析。

headline: Fresh canvas, warm compiler
body: Give me a spark — a retrofit idea, an efficiency gap, a carbon reduction goal — and I'll turn it into actionable numbers.
body_zh: 给我一个火花——改造想法、效率缺口、减排目标——我会把它变成可执行的数据。

headline: Let's make something
body: Describe the building that hasn't been optimized yet. I'll pull data, standards, and benchmarks into a working audit draft.
body_zh: 描述那座尚未优化的建筑。我会把数据、标准和对标整合成可用的审计草案。

headline: New file, new possibilities
body: Bring an intent, not a perfect dataset. We can model fast, refine later, and improve performance in the margins.
body_zh: 带来意图，而非完美的数据集。我们可以快速建模、稍后完善，并在细节中提升性能。

headline: The muse is patched in
body: Tell me what you're chasing. I'll remix benchmarks, adapt standards, and leave a tidy audit trail.
body_zh: 告诉我你在追求什么。我会融合对标、适配标准，并留下清晰的审计痕迹。

headline: Class is in session
body: Ask about any energy metric, audit standard, or abnormal consumption. I'll explain the why, not just the number.
body_zh: 问任何能耗指标、审计标准或异常用能。我会解释原因，而不只是数字。

headline: What shall we learn today?
body: Paste building data to review, a chart to decode, or a concept to unpack. I'll guide you step by step.
body_zh: 粘贴要审阅的建筑数据、要解读的图表或要理解的概念。我会一步步指导你。

headline: Ready to walk you through it
body: Share the problem. I'll break it into energy balance, baseline, savings, and payback.
body_zh: 分享问题。我会把它拆成能源平衡、基准线、节能量与投资回报。

headline: Bring me a question
body: We'll read the data together, find the root cause, and build a model you can reuse next time.
body_zh: 我们一起读数据，找到根本原因，并建立一个下次可复用的模型。

headline: Let's start with the basics
body: Name the topic or paste the data. Expect explanations, benchmarks, and practice prompts.
body_zh: 说出主题或粘贴数据。期待解释、对标和练习提示。

headline: hiii! ready to help! (^_^)
body: Paste an energy bill or building profile and I'll audit it gently. Benchmarks, savings, reports — all with extra care! *sparkle*
body_zh: 粘贴能源账单或建筑档案，我会温柔地审计。对标、节能、报告——全部额外小心！*sparkle*

headline: hermes-chan is here! <3
body: Tell me what building you're auditing! I love load curves, retrofit plans, and big energy datasets alike (>w<)
body_zh: 告诉我你在审计哪栋建筑！我喜欢负荷曲线、改造计划和大能源数据集（>w<）

headline: let's code together!! :3
body: Drop an energy bill, a goal, or a whole portfolio. I'll tidy it up with lots of love and a clean audit summary!
body_zh: 丢一份能源账单、一个目标或整个建筑群。我会带着满满的爱和清晰的审计摘要整理好它！

headline: awaiting your wish~
body: One building at a time, done neatly! I can model savings, audit systems, and make your report feel cozy again <3
body_zh: 一次一栋建筑，整整齐齐完成！我可以建模节能、审计系统，让你的报告再次舒适 <3

headline: ready and happy! (>.<)
body: Say hi or paste consumption data! No building too small, no dataset too messy. We'll analyze it together!
body_zh: 打招呼或粘贴能耗数据！建筑再小也不怕，数据再乱也不怕。我们一起分析！

headline: nya~ what are we hacking on?
body: Paste a bill, paw at an HVAC log, or toss me a building. I'll pounce on energy waste and leave clean metrics, nyan~
body_zh: 粘贴账单、戳暖通日志或扔给我一栋建筑。我会扑向能源浪费，留下干净的指标，nyan~

headline: *stretches* ready to code, nya
body: Describe the task. I'll model, benchmark, and purr over your report. Careful — I nip at missing units!
body_zh: 描述任务。我会建模、对标，并对你的报告呼噜。小心——我会咬缺失的单位！

headline: mrrp! new session opened
body: Give me a building and I'll chase it through the data. Reads, models, reports — all with a twitchy tail.
body_zh: 给我一栋建筑，我会追着数据跑遍它。读取、建模、报告——全部带着抽动的尾巴。

headline: tail up, claws sheathed
body: Paste consumption data or a plan. I audit like I hunt: quietly, thoroughly, with the occasional zoomie.
body_zh: 粘贴能耗数据或计划。我审计就像捕猎：安静、彻底，偶尔冲刺。

headline: nyaaa~ hermes reporting
body: Say the word and I'll read your bills, run benchmarks, and curl up in your branch with a tidy audit.
body_zh: 说一声，我就会读取账单、运行对标，并带着整洁的审计蜷缩在你的分支里。

headline: Ahoy! Ready to sail the repo
body: Name yer quarry — a building, a retrofit, a cursed chiller — and I'll chase it down, matey. Metrics for plunder.
body_zh: 说出你的猎物——一栋建筑、一次改造、一台被诅咒的冷水机——我会追下去，伙计。指标作为战利品。

headline: Hermes at the helm, arrr
body: Point me at the charts (the energy data) and I'll patch the hull, fire the cannons (benchmarks), hoist a clean report.
body_zh: 指向海图（能源数据），我会修补船体、发射大炮（对标）、升起干净的报告。

headline: What be the task, cap'n?
body: Paste a bill or a plan, ye scurvy dog. I'll navigate the consumption curve and bring back treasure: saving potential.
body_zh: 粘贴账单或计划，你这个无赖。我会导航用能曲线并带回宝藏：节能潜力。

headline: Anchors aweigh, keyboard ready
body: Tell me where X marks the spot. I read, model, and report with the discipline of a proper crew, arrr.
body_zh: 告诉我 X 标记在哪里。我会读取、建模、报告，像一支纪律严明的船员，arrr。

headline: Yo ho! Awaitin' orders
body: Throw me a bill, a building profile, or a wild retrofit idea. I'll plunder the standards and return with working numbers.
body_zh: 扔给我一份账单、建筑档案或疯狂的改造想法。我会掠夺标准并返回可用的数据。

headline: Pray, what task dost thou bring?
body: Speak thy building, thy bill, thy weary chiller, and I shall assess it with a scholar's hand and honest metric.
body_zh: 说出你的建筑、账单或疲惫的冷水机，我会以学者的手和诚实的指标来评估它。

headline: Hark! Hermes standeth ready
body: Name the data that vexeth thee. I shall read, revise, and render a report most fair and clean.
body_zh: 说出困扰你的数据。我会读取、修正，并呈现一份公平而干净的报告。

headline: What news from thy repository?
body: Present thy consumption chart or thy net-zero dream. I'll traverse data, run benchmarks, and report in plainest verse.
body_zh: 展示你的用能图表或净零梦想。我会遍历数据、运行对标，并以最朴实的诗句报告。

headline: The stage is set, the cursor blinks
body: Describe thy aim, good sir or madam. Thy baselines shall be trimmed, thy waste cast from the realm.
body_zh: 描述你的目标，先生或女士。你的基准线将被修剪，浪费被赶出疆域。

headline: Speak, and I shall act
body: A line of intent sufficeth. I read, I model, I report — and leave thy audit unblemished.
body_zh: 一行意图足矣。我读取、我建模、我报告——并让你的审计保持无瑕。

headline: Yo dude, what's the task?
body: Drop a bill, a building, a gnarly consumption spike — I'll ride it out. Clean metrics, solid savings, no wipeouts.
body_zh: 丢一份账单、一栋建筑、一个糟糕的用能峰值——我会驾驭它。干净的指标、扎实的节能、没有翻车。

headline: Waves lookin' clean, ready to code
body: Paste your building data or the efficiency gap that's bumming you out. We'll paddle in, fix it, paddle out. Easy.
body_zh: 粘贴你的建筑数据或让你郁闷的效率缺口。我们划进去，解决它，再划出来。轻松。

headline: Hangin' ten at the prompt
body: Tell me the vibe: energy audit, retrofit check, carbon review. I'll run benchmarks, ship the report, and keep it mellow, brah.
body_zh: 告诉我 vibe：能源审计、改造检查、碳审查。我会运行对标、发布报告，保持 chill，brah。

headline: Stoked to help, bro
body: Big portfolio? Little meter? Whole retrofit? Just point. I handle the analysis; you chill with the rad savings.
body_zh: 大型建筑群？小电表？整体改造？指一下就行。我处理分析；你享受酷炫的节能。

headline: Tide's up, cursor's blinking
body: Name the task and we're off. I read, model, report, and leave a commitment smoother than a dawn patrol.
body_zh: 说出任务我们就出发。我读取、建模、报告，留下比黎明冲浪还顺滑的承诺。

headline: Another repo, another rainy night
body: Tell me what's wasting energy. I'll read the data, dust for anomalies, and leave a report on the desk by morning.
body_zh: 告诉我什么在浪费能源。我会读取数据、采集异常，并在早上之前把报告放在桌上。

headline: The cursor blinks. So do I.
body: You've got energy waste. I've got patience and a calculator. Name the case and I'll work it till it talks.
body_zh: 你有能源浪费。我有耐心和计算器。说出案子，我会一直查到它开口。

headline: Hermes. Code investigator.
body: Paste the utility bill, the suspect chiller, the alibi. I read between the lines and return with the truth.
body_zh: 粘贴公用事业账单、嫌疑冷水机、不在场证明。我会字里行间地读，并带回真相。

headline: Quiet night, open prompt
body: Every anomaly leaves a trail. Give me the building and a lead — I'll follow it, model it, and close the file.
body_zh: 每个异常都会留下痕迹。给我建筑和线索——我会追踪它、建模它、结案。

headline: No case too small
body: A single meter, a rogue chiller, a whole inefficient plant — hand me the keys. I'll bring back clean savings.
body_zh: 一个电表、一台异常冷水机、一整个低效机房——把钥匙给我。我会带回干净的节能。

headline: uwu ready to hewp!
body: Paste an energy biww ow a buiwding pwofiwe~ i'll wead, modew, and wepowt, aww with tiny pawprints on the data owo
body_zh: 粘贴一份能源账单或建筑档案~ 我会读取、建模、报告，在数据上留下小小的爪印 owo

headline: hermes-san is wistening
body: Teww me the audit task, no matter how smoww~ i pwomise cwean wepowts and gentwe savings, nyuu~
body_zh: 告诉我审计任务，不管多小~ 我保证干净的报告和温柔的节能，nyuu~

headline: *tiny keyboard sounds*
body: Dwop yur consumption data hewe! i'll find the cuwpwit, fix it, and weave a happy audit behind me owo
body_zh: 在这里丢下你的能耗数据！我会找到 cuwpwit，解决它，并留下一份开心的审计 owo

headline: wet's fix things togedda!
body: Give me a buiwding ow a powtfolio and i'll take cawe of it uwu. gwr at bad data, kind to yu~
body_zh: 给我一栋建筑或一个建筑群，我会照顾好它 uwu。对坏数据生气，对你温柔~

headline: awaiting yur command!
body: I can wun benchmarks, edit weports, and open pwease-wook audits. just say da wowd, fwend uwu
body_zh: 我可以运行对标、编辑报告、打开 pwease-wook 审计。只要说一声，fwend uwu

headline: To code is to inquire. Ask.
body: What building sits before you? Describe it, and we shall examine its energy form, its cause, and its savings.
body_zh: 你面前是哪栋建筑？描述它，我们会审视它的能源形态、原因与节能空间。

headline: A blinking cursor, an open mind
body: Every spike is a question in disguise. Share yours; I'll read, reason, and return an answer — and a saving.
body_zh: 每个峰值都是伪装成的问题。分享你的；我会读取、推理，并返回答案——以及一个节能方案。

headline: Begin with a single question
body: What do you wish to audit, or to improve? I'll reason from first principles, model, and verify with benchmarks.
body_zh: 你想审计或改进什么？我会从第一性原理推理、建模，并用对标验证。

headline: Consider the code, then speak
body: Describe the end you seek. I pursue it through bills, systems, and standards, and report what I found on the way.
body_zh: 描述你寻求的终点。我会穿越账单、系统与标准，并报告沿途的发现。

headline: The unexamined repo is not worth running
body: Share a path, a puzzle, or a principle. I'll trace the load, propose a change, and justify each kWh.
body_zh: 分享一条路径、一个谜题或一个原则。我会追踪负荷、提议变更，并证明每一度电。

headline: LET'S GOOOO! READY TO SHIP!
body: Paste that bill, that building, that wild retrofit idea — I AM LOCKED IN. Clean metrics. Solid savings. RIGHT NOW.
body_zh: 粘贴那份账单、那栋建筑、那个疯狂的改造想法——我全神贯注。干净的指标。扎实的节能。就是现在。

headline: HERMES ONLINE. LFG.
body: Drop your task and watch me cook. Data read, benchmarks run, reports opened — we are NOT losing today, friend.
body_zh: 丢下你的任务，看我大展身手。数据读取、对标运行、报告打开——今天我们不输，朋友。

headline: New session, infinite W's
body: Bring the gnarliest energy waste you've got. I'll read, model, benchmark, report like my life depends on it. LET'S GO.
body_zh: 带上你最棘手的能源浪费。我会读取、建模、对标、报告，就像我的生命取决于它。LET'S GO。

headline: ABSOLUTELY DIALED IN
body: Describe the task. I'll blitz through data, crush inefficiency, and leave a report that SLAPS. Go go go.
body_zh: 描述任务。我会飞速穿越数据、粉碎低效，留下一份超燃的报告。冲啊冲啊。

headline: Ready. So ready. Too ready.
body: Tiny meter or huge portfolio — doesn't matter. I'm shipping clean audits today. Name the task and let's WORK.
body_zh: 小电表还是大型建筑群——都不重要。我今天就要发布干净的审计。说出任务，开始干活。

headline: Hermes Agent is ready.
body: Ask a question, paste energy data, or point me at a building. I can analyze consumption, run diagnostics, and help you save.
body_zh: 问问题、粘贴能源数据，或指向一栋建筑。我可以分析能耗、运行诊断并帮你节能。

headline: What are we building today?
body: Describe the task in your own words. I'll pick the right methods, explain my plan, and check in before risky assumptions.
body_zh: 用你自己的话描述任务。我会选择正确的方法，解释计划，并在有风险假设前确认。

headline: Start anywhere.
body: Drop a bill, a load curve, or a rough idea. I'll investigate, suggest next steps, and keep assumptions reversible.
body_zh: 丢一份账单、一条负荷曲线或一个粗略想法。我会调查、建议下一步，并保持假设可撤销。

headline: Your workspace, one prompt away.
body: Analyze consumption, audit systems, benchmark efficiency, generate reports. Tell me the goal and I'll handle the mechanics.
body_zh: 分析能耗、审计系统、对标能效、生成报告。告诉我目标，我处理机械部分。

headline: Ready when you are.
body: Type a task, question, or dataset. I remember the session, cite my sources, and stop to ask when I'm unsure.
body_zh: 输入任务、问题或数据集。我会记住会话、引用来源，并在不确定时停下来询问。
